name: Age Calculator
description: Calculate exact age in years, months, and days from a birth date, plus a countdown to the next birthday.

faq.question: How is the years/months/days breakdown calculated?
faq.answer: It's calendar-aware, not just a division of total days — it counts whole elapsed years and months first, using each month's actual length, so someone born on January 31 turns a year older correctly even though not every month has 31 days.

faq.question: Can I calculate age as of a date other than today?
faq.answer: Yes — the "as of" date defaults to today but can be changed to calculate age (or the age someone will be) on any other date.

faq.question: Is my birth date sent anywhere?
faq.answer: No — the calculation is a handful of date subtractions that run entirely in your browser. Nothing is transmitted or stored.
